name: markdown-section-runs-to-same-level-heading
description: The "## Context" section runs to the next heading of the same or a higher level: the deeper "### Exclusions" stays inside, "## Question style" ends it. The block text excludes the heading line. The section, heading included, is removed from system_instructions; the text before it and the "## Question style" section stay.
